blocks.prompt: 7. Resolve into partial fractions: \(\frac{x^2 + a^2}{(x^2 + b^2)(x^2 + c^2)(x^2 + d^2)}\) [Hint: Put \(x^2 = y\) to make factors of the denominator linear]
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein har jagah sirf \(x^2\) aata hai, akela \(x\) kahin nahi. Kitab ka hint kehta hai \(x^2 = y\) rakh do; tab neeche teen mukhtalif linear factors ban jate hain (y mein Case I).
Teen constants nikalenge jo numbers nahi balke \(a, b, c, d\) ki shakal mein honge.
Plan: substitution, identity, \(y = -b^2, -c^2, -d^2\) rakhna, tasdeeq, phir \(y\) ki jagah \(x^2\) wapas.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x^2 + a^2}{(x^2 + b^2)(x^2 + c^2)(x^2 + d^2)}\) (\(b^2, c^2, d^2\) aapas mein mukhtalif)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Hint ke mutabiq \(x^2 = y\) rakhein. Har factor \(y + b^2\) y mein linear hai, is liye Case I lag jata hai. Aakhir mein \(y\) ki jagah \(x^2\) wapas likhenge.

\(x^2 = y\) rakhein
\[\dfrac{y + a^2}{(y + b^2)(y + c^2)(y + d^2)}\]
Kyun: Ab y mein upar degree 1 aur neeche degree 3, yani proper fraction, aur factors mukhtalif linear hain. Is tarah ek mushkil lagne wala sawal ek seedha Case I ban gaya.

Shakal aur identity likhein
\[= \dfrac{A}{y + b^2} + \dfrac{B}{y + c^2} + \dfrac{C}{y + d^2}\]
\[y + a^2 = A(y + c^2)(y + d^2)\]
\[+ B(y + b^2)(y + d^2)\]
\[+ C(y + b^2)(y + c^2) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Poore denominator se multiply kiya; har constant ke saath woh do factors bache jo us ke fraction mein nahi the.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(y = -b^2\) rakhein
\[a^2 - b^2 = A(c^2 - b^2)(d^2 - b^2)\]
\[A = \dfrac{a^2 - b^2}{(c^2 - b^2)(d^2 - b^2)}\]
Kyun: \(y + b^2 = 0\), to \(B\) aur \(C\) wale terms ghayab. \(-b^2 + c^2\) ko \(c^2 - b^2\) likhna sirf tarteeb badalna hai, value wohi hai.

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(y = -c^2\) rakhein
\[a^2 - c^2 = B(b^2 - c^2)(d^2 - c^2)\]
\[B = \dfrac{a^2 - c^2}{(b^2 - c^2)(d^2 - c^2)}\]
Kyun: \(y + c^2 = 0\), sirf \(B\) bachta hai. Bilkul \(A\) wala pattern: jis factor ka zero rakha, us ke ilawa baaqi do brackets mein value daal kar tarteeb seedhi kar lein.

\(C\) nikalein: (i) mein \(y = -d^2\) rakhein
\[a^2 - d^2 = C(b^2 - d^2)(c^2 - d^2)\]
\[C = \dfrac{a^2 - d^2}{(b^2 - d^2)(c^2 - d^2)}\]
Kyun: \(y + d^2 = 0\), sirf \(C\) bachta hai. Pattern yaad rakhein: upar \(a^2\) minus apna square, neeche (doosre square minus apna square) ka zarb.

Coefficients compare karein (numbers rakh kar test)
(i) mein \(y^2\) ka coefficient \(A + B + C = 0\) dena chahiye. \(a = 4,\ b = 1,\ c = 2,\ d = 3\) lein:
\[A = \tfrac{15}{24} = \tfrac{5}{8},\ B = \tfrac{12}{-15} = -\tfrac{4}{5}\]
\[C = \tfrac{7}{40}\]
\[\tfrac{25}{40} - \tfrac{32}{40} + \tfrac{7}{40} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Baayen taraf \(y + a^2\) mein \(y^2\) nahi hai. Letters wale formulas ko chhote numbers se test karna sign ki ghalti pakarne ka sab se tez tareeqa hai.

\(y = x^2\) wapas rakh kar jawab likhein
\[\dfrac{a^2 - b^2}{(c^2 - b^2)(d^2 - b^2)(x^2 + b^2)}\]
\[+ \dfrac{a^2 - c^2}{(b^2 - c^2)(d^2 - c^2)(x^2 + c^2)}\]
\[+ \dfrac{a^2 - d^2}{(b^2 - d^2)(c^2 - d^2)(x^2 + d^2)}\]
Kyun: Sawal \(x\) mein tha, is liye jawab bhi \(x\) mein hona chahiye; \(y\) sirf madad ke liye tha. Bohat se students \(y\) wala jawab hi likh kar chhor dete hain, aur is par number kat-te hain.
Dhyan dein: \(x^2 + b^2\) asal mein irreducible quadratic hai, lekin yahan \(x\) wala hissa zero nikalta hai, is liye upar sirf constant aata hai.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
Common denominator par numerator \(N(y)\) ki degree zyada se zyada 2 hai. \(y = -b^2\) par sirf pehla term bachta hai aur \(A(c^2 - b^2)(d^2 - b^2) = a^2 - b^2\) deta hai; isi tarah \(-c^2\) aur \(-d^2\) par. Yani \(N(y)\) aur \(y + a^2\) teen mukhtalif values par barabar hain, is liye \(N(y) = y + a^2\) \(\checkmark\)
Numbers se test (\(a = 4, b = 1, c = 2, d = 3, x = 0\)):
\[\tfrac{5}{8} - \tfrac{4}{5 \cdot 4} + \tfrac{7}{40 \cdot 9} = \tfrac{4}{9}\]
\[\tfrac{16}{1 \cdot 4 \cdot 9} = \tfrac{4}{9} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Degree 2 tak ke do polynomials agar teen points par barabar hon to woh bilkul ek hi polynomial hote hain. Letters wale lambe jor ki jagah yeh saaf aur pakka tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein denominators ke brackets ke andar minus ke nishan chhape hi nahi (jaise \((c^2\ b^2)(d^2\ b^2)\) parhne mein aata hai). Yeh farq hain: \((c^2 - b^2)(d^2 - b^2)\), \((b^2 - c^2)(d^2 - c^2)\) aur \((b^2 - d^2)(c^2 - d^2)\), jaisa upar hal kiya gaya.
